source: 上外版必修第一册 Unit 3 同主题完形(一次海边旅行/准备行李/在古城迷路/选择旅行城市/第一次坐飞机/状语从句串联的旅行小记)。用词限 U3/初中/常见词,答案唯一、同词性,与阅读关不撞文章。

passages.title: A Day at the Seaside
passages.text: Last summer my family took a short (1)____ to a small seaside town. We set off early in the morning (2)____ we could arrive before the crowds. As soon as we got there, I could not (3)____ my eyes away from the bright blue water. The town was (4)____ beautiful that we decided to stay an extra day. In the afternoon we walked along the beach and looked for shells. My little sister made a great (5)____ to build a sandcastle, but a wave soon washed it away. For lunch we (6)____ the popular seafood of the region, which tasted wonderful. Later we bought a few small (7)____ to take home for our friends. Although we were tired, the trip was (8)____ a happy one that none of us wanted to leave. On the way back, we already began to (9)____ a course for our next holiday. A short journey like this can (10)____ many good memories.

questions.explanation: take a short trip 短途旅行。
目的'为了'早到 → so that。
tear one's eyes away 移开目光。
so + 形容词 beautiful → so…that。
make a great effort 努力。
tasted the seafood 品尝海鲜。
buy souvenirs 买纪念品。
such + a + 形容词 + 名词 → such…that。
chart a course 制定计划。
create memories 创造回忆。

passages.title: Getting Ready to Pack
passages.text: Packing well is an important skill for every (1)____. The night before a trip, you should make a clear (2)____ of everything you need to take. Try to pack light, (3)____ a heavy bag is hard to carry through a busy airport. Most airlines allow only one (4)____ item of hand luggage for free. (5)____ you bring a second bag onto the plane, they will charge you a fee. So a wise traveller never packs anything that is not (6)____ to the trip. Remember to keep your passport and tickets where you can (7)____ them quickly. It is also helpful to (8)____ the weather of the place you are visiting, (9)____ you will know what clothes to bring. With a little planning (10)____, packing becomes quick and easy, and you can start your journey without any worry.

questions.explanation: every traveller 每位旅行者。
make a list 列清单。
给出'轻装'的原因 → because。
carry-on item 随身物品。
'如果'多带一个包 → 条件 If。
relevant to the trip 与旅行相关。
reach them quickly 能快速拿到。
check the weather 查天气。
目的'这样你就……' → so that。
planning ahead 提前规划。

passages.title: Lost in the Old Town
passages.text: On our second day, my friend and I got (1)____ in the narrow streets of the old town. The little map was (2)____ confusing that we soon had no idea where we were. (3)____ we felt a little worried, the walk turned into a small adventure. (4)____ we turned a corner, we saw something new and interesting. We passed quiet squares (5)____ old men were playing chess in the sun. We kept walking (6)____ we finally reached a busy market full of colour and noise. A kind shopkeeper (7)____ us the way back to our hotel and even drew a simple map for us. (8)____ we had lost our way, that afternoon became my favourite part of the whole trip. Sometimes getting lost lets you (9)____ a city in a way that no guidebook can. Now I always say that a wrong turn can (10)____ to the best surprises.

questions.explanation: get lost 迷路。
so + 形容词 confusing → so…that。
担心却变成冒险,转折 → Although。
'无论拐到哪里' → 地点 Wherever。
quiet squares where 地点状语从句 → where。
一直走'直到'到达市场 → until。
showed us the way 给我们指路。
迷了路却成最爱,转折 → Although。
explore a city 探索城市。
lead to surprises 带来惊喜。

passages.title: Choosing a City to Visit
passages.text: My friend Emily has an (1)____ to visit a Chinese city this winter, so she asked us for some advice. We held a discussion to help her (2)____ which place to choose. I strongly (3)____ Xi'an, an amazing historic city in the northwest. It enjoys a long (4)____, because it was once the capital of many dynasties. Its most famous (5)____ is the army of terracotta warriors, which were built more than two thousand years ago. They are (6)____ lifelike that visitors often gasp in surprise. (7)____ Emily prefers a city with history, Xi'an would be a perfect choice. She should also try the local (8)____, such as warm bread soaked in lamb soup. I told her that she cannot know how wonderful the city is (9)____ she goes there herself. With three days, she will have just enough time to enjoy the sights and (10)____ wonderful memories.

questions.explanation: have an opportunity 有机会。
decide which place 决定选哪里。
recommend Xi'an 推荐西安。
a long history 悠久历史。
famous attraction 著名景点。
so + 形容词 lifelike → so…that。
给原因'因为她偏爱历史' → Since。
local food 当地食物。
'除非'亲自去,否则不知道 → unless。
create memories 创造回忆。

passages.title: My First Flight
passages.text: I will never forget the day (1)____ I took my very first flight. I was both excited and a little (2)____ as the plane began to move. (3)____ it slowly rose into the sky, the houses below grew smaller and smaller. Soon we were flying above the clouds, and the view was (4)____ amazing that I could not stop staring out of the window. A kind flight worker brought us drinks and a meal (5)____ we felt comfortable. The flight was (6)____ a long one that most passengers fell asleep before we landed. (7)____ I was tired, I stayed awake to watch the sunset from high above the earth. When we finally (8)____ from the plane, I felt like a real traveller. I had learned that flying is much faster (9)____ travelling by train or coach. From that day on, I have (10)____ every chance to see new places by air.

questions.explanation: the day when 时间状语从句 → when。
a little afraid 有点害怕。
随着飞机上升(同时)→ 时间 As。
so + 形容词 amazing → so…that。
目的'为了让我们舒适' → so that。
such + a + 形容词 + 名词 → such…that。
累却保持清醒,转折 → Although。
departed from the plane 下飞机。
faster…than 比……更快 → than。

passages.title: A Mountain Trip to Remember
passages.text: Two friends and I planned a mountain trip (1)____ we wanted to see the sunrise from the top. We got up very early (2)____ we could start climbing before dawn. (3)____ we walked, a cold wind blew across the path, but the beautiful (4)____ kept us going. We did not stop (5)____ we reached a small flat area near the top. (6)____ the climb was hard, none of us wanted to give up. At last the sun rose, and the view was (7)____ breathtaking that we stood in silence for a while. We took many photos (8)____ we could show our families back home. (9)____ you have stood on a mountain at sunrise, it is hard to imagine the feeling. That trip taught me that the best (10)____ are often the ones that take the most effort.

目的'为了天亮前出发' → so that。
随着我们走(同时)→ 时间 As。

没停'直到'到达平地 → until。
难却不放弃,转折 → Although。
